QUOTE: "It uses the facility to install its own allocator. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) takes a caller-supplied buffer, sets up an in-buffer heap that never calls `calloc`/`free`, and registers itself with `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init registers itself via the setter, but it never says it is the only in-tree user. It also never names MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C. The "only user" claim is missing.
